title: Defus: open scans of printed Hebrew books
description:
Open scans of printed Hebrew books and Judaica, 1469–1920, gathered from the libraries that hold them.

Harvested from library catalogues (HathiTrust, Internet Archive, Munich, Frankfurt and others); editions grouped into works. The scans stay with the libraries; rights are per copy.

Read online: https://openseforim.org/defus/
